widgets_values:
KEYFRAMES (optional)

I2V image = the first frame of SHOT 1 only.
START frames / END frames = one image PER SHOT: make a folder under ComfyUI/input (e.g. input/myshots_start), put one image per shot in it named in shot order (01.png, 02.png ...), pick the folder here, flip it on. Fewer images than shots = the last one repeats. START = how each shot begins (cut / fresh modes), END = the frame each shot travels to.
identity_ref on the sampler keeps the same people across shots WITHOUT any images.

nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
START HERE - JOY-LTX 2.5 MULTISHOT (one story, several shots, one video)

The writer turns your premise into N shot prompts; the sampler renders each shot with the two-pass pipeline and JOINS them:
- continue = the previous shot's last frames AND sound are pinned into the next one -> one seamless take of any length (writer join style "extend take").
- cut = only the sound is pinned: the voice carries across a picture cut, the picture follows the new shot prompt (writer "cuts" / "continuous scene with cuts").
- fresh = independent shots.
Same people in every shot: identity_ref (on the sampler) attaches a frame of shot 1 to the later shots - no reference photos needed. identity_strength 0.3-0.6 keeps the people and lets the framing move; 1.0 copies the framing too.

1. SCENE IDEA. 2. Writer: num_shots = how many shots (and a model you have). 3. MASTER CONTROLS: render size + seconds PER SHOT + upscale (auto; x2/x1.5/none by hand if you accept streaming). 4. Writer join style to match the join. 5. USE I2V (optional): first frame of shot 1. 6. Run.

VRAM = one shot; take length = shots x seconds. Fewer, longer shots = fewer joins (24 GB: 4 x 30 s single pass works). Read-me note: models + links.

TWO PEOPLE IN A SCENE: use cut, not continue. The pinned picture is what makes continue seamless, so when the speaker changes the new person gets painted into the old body and room - a reference photo will not overcome the pin (render-verified). In cut mode the whole pin follows whoever is speaking: their own last frame and their own voice. continue is for one person talking through a take.

nodes.title: WRITER
widgets_values:
THE WRITER

long_story (multi-shot): writes SHOTS prompts, each sized to the seconds per shot. join style "extend take" = one continuous speech across shots (use with continue); "cuts" or "continuous scene with cuts" = each shot its own beat (use with cut / fresh).
Cloud model returned 503 / empty? Pick another model and Run again.
No writer? mode = passthrough and paste shot prompts separated by --- into the sampler's prompts box.
Shot count lives HERE, on num_shots - not on MASTER CONTROLS. beat_seconds does nothing on this canvas (it sizes the beats inside one generation on the single-shot Take canvas); here every shot is seconds-per-shot long and there are num_shots of them.

PLUS LANES

LoRA stack - up to four LoRAs on the DiT; (none) or strength 0 = skipped. On a DEV merge, the official LTX-2.5 distilled LoRA at 0.4-0.6 is what makes it few-step.

Casting from folders. Put photos in ComfyUI/input/<refs_root>/<character>/ - one folder per character, the folder name is the name you use in the prompt (refs_root is a dropdown of the libraries it finds).

The node reads the shot prompts, finds the named character, and hands the sampler one photo per shot; the sampler attaches it at frame 0 (ref_strength 0.5), and from a character's second shot on their own rendered face and their own voice carry into every later shot of theirs.

pick - 'one per character' uses the same photo for a character all the way through (best identity). Write [ref: name] in a shot to force a particular character; the marker is stripped before rendering.

crop - portrait keeps the person and drops the room. Use portraits or clean character shots: a busy scene photo drags its set into the render.

PROMPTS FROM FILE - write the shots yourself (--- between shots, or JSON) in input/joyltx_prompts/ and wire this node into REFS BY NAME in place of the writer.

save audio - the finished soundtrack as flac next to the video.

nodes.title: JOY-LTX 2.5 - read me
widgets_values:
## Joy-LTX 2.5 - JoyAI-Echo's performance on LTX-2.5

**DiT file** (models/diffusion_models): pick by card and GPU family. Both doses in every tier: **070T30** (default) / **100T50** (livelier; same links with `100T50` in the name).
- 16 GB: [Q4_K_S.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-Q4_K_S.gguf) (RTX 30/40) · [comfy-w4a8](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-comfy-w4a8.safetensors) or [comfy-nvfp4](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-comfy-nvfp4.safetensors) (RTX 50) · 12 GB: [Q3_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-Q3_K_M.gguf)
- 24 GB: [Q5_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-Q5_K_M.gguf) (RTX 30/40, the default) · [Q6_K.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-Q6_K.gguf) · [comfy-mix4x8-17.0GB](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-comfy-mix4x8-17.0GB.safetensors) (RTX 50)
- 32 GB: [comfy-int8](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-comfy-int8.safetensors) (fastest on RTX 50) · [Q8_0.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf/blob/main/LTX25dist-echoVid-070T30-v2-DiT-Q8_0.gguf)
The canvas loader (**JoyLTX Load Model**) takes either family; `.gguf` needs **ComfyUI-GGUF** installed. RTX 30/40 = GGUF, RTX 50 = comfy-native.
All files: [GGUF repo](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf) · [comfy-native repo](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native) · [dev merges](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-dev) (bf16/fp8/int8, add your own distill LoRA) · Civitai: **Joy-LTX 2.5**.

**Also needed** (Lightricks/LTX-2.5 on Hugging Face): `ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16` + `ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16` -> models/vae · `ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0` -> models/latent_upscale_models (optional for 24 GB: `ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x1.5-1.0` from LTX-2.3) · text encoder `gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot` -> models/text_encoders (16 GB: the 10.6 GB `gemma4-12b-ltx25-comfy-w4a8` from LTX-2.5-Quantized).

**Writer**: `writer_pack/ComfyUI_JoyAI_Echo_GGUF_Nodes` from this zip -> custom_nodes (our writing rules are inside; the Manager copy lacks them). Point it at an Ollama with a cloud model, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

**Speed**: on RTX 50 add `--enable-triton-backend` to the launch line for comfy-native files (about 2x). GGUF is unaffected.

Models: huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-gguf · huggingface.co/joeygambino/joyai-echo-ltx25-echoVid-comfy-native
Nodes + canvases: github.com/jlucasmcrell/ComfyUI-JoyLTX25

STORY SOURCE

Where a run's words come from - one panel, three sources.

scene idea (the box) - type a premise in the SCENE IDEA box. The writer turns it into shot prompts.

idea file - a file of story IDEAS; INDEX picks one and the writer expands it. Pick the file from the dropdown (everything under ComfyUI/input; entries ending in / are whole folders and then INDEX picks the file). An idea is a few sentences: who is there, what the camera is, what happens, how it ends. Leave INDEX on increment and queue once per idea to work through a file unattended - it wraps at the end.

shot file - finished shot prompts (--- on its own line between shots, or JSON). The writer is skipped; what you wrote is what renders.

refs_attached - ON: the writer uses each character's own name and writes 'looks exactly as in the reference photographs' instead of inventing a face, which is what REFS BY NAME needs to cast them. OFF: no photos, the writer describes people itself.

manual_path - only for a file outside ComfyUI/input; leave empty otherwise.

New files do not appear in the dropdowns until ComfyUI is refreshed (R) or restarted.

nodes.title: ENGINE - LTX-2.5 two-pass
widgets_values:
ENGINE: LTX-2.5 MULTISHOT sampler.

One node = the whole two-pass pipeline per shot (pass 1, latent upscale x2/x1.5, pass 2, decode) plus the join. overlap = latent frames of the previous shot pinned at the head of the next (3 = 0.7 s, trimmed on output). identity_ref / identity_strength = same people across shots. seed_per_shot varies the seed by shot. save_every_shot writes raw shots to output/video/JOYLTX_SHOTS. Optional: shot_images (one image per shot, cut/fresh) if you have plates.

nodes.title: MASTER CONTROLS (render size / seconds PER SHOT / upscale)

widgets_values:
REFS BY NAME

Casting from folders. Photos go in ComfyUI/input/<refs_root>/<character>/ - one folder per character; the folder name is the name you write in the prompt (refs_root is a dropdown of the libraries found).

The node reads the shot prompts, finds the named character and hands the sampler one photo per shot; the sampler attaches it at frame 0 (ref_strength 0.5). From a character's second shot on, their own rendered face and their own voice carry into every later shot of theirs.

pick - 'one per character' uses the same photo for that character all the way through (best identity). Write [ref: name] in a shot to force one; the marker is stripped before rendering.

crop - portrait keeps the person and drops the room. Use portraits or clean character shots; a busy scene photo drags its set into the render.

Needs refs_attached ON in STORY SOURCE, or the writer invents faces instead of naming people.

HOW HARD THE PHOTO PULLS (ref_strength on the sampler, measured on one seed)
0.5 - you get the hair and the clothes, but the face is somebody else.
0.85 (default) - the face, and the small things: glasses, a piercing.
1.0 - the photograph's own room comes with it. Use only if you want that.

AGE IS NOT IN THE PHOTOGRAPH. The model renders an adult unless the prompt says otherwise, and a reference photo of a teenager will not stop it. Say the age in the premise ("Dana, sixteen") and the writer carries one plain age phrase into every shot. Everything else about how the person looks stays out of the words and comes from the pictures.

ONE-OFF PHOTO INSTEAD OF THE LIBRARY: add 'JoyLTX Ref Image (manual)', wire a Load Image into it and its ref_images + ref_mask straight to the sampler (same two inputs this node feeds). One image covers every shot; a batch is one per shot. Name the character on it and the identity + voice locks apply, exactly as if they had a folder.
